credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: A Winsor & Newton Japanned watercolor palette set belonging to Georgia O'Keeffe;   black tin half pan box containing 24 removable watercolor paint cakes. The spectrum of paint cakes are housed in individual small plastic containers with a WN color label on the base. The white coating on interior of the box has numerous large abrasions and scratches where the paint has been skinned into the metal along with splotches of paint in blues, greens, reds, and pink. The black exterior of the box also has numerous abrasions and scratches into the metal with splotches of blue paint. On the base of the box, on the verso, is a metal ring.
title: Japanned Watercolor Box
